verdict.rationale: Elastic's own ES|QL REST API can return query results in human-readable and binary formats, selected with a `format` parameter or HTTP header. That is a documented, product-native way to pull data out, but the evidence never describes a bulk 'export everything and leave' path or names the open formats. The 'no vendor lock-in' and OpenTelemetry claims cover data collection only, so they are adjacent and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented full-data bulk export or migration tooling, explicit list of open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/Parquet/OTLP), export of dashboards, rules and config, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: ES|QL can return the data in the following human readable and binary formats.
You can set the format by specifying the `format` parameter in the URL or by setting the `Accept` or `Content-Type` HTTP header.
